cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a board-game café — crouching low on her heels; a university festival lane of booths under bunting and paper lanterns — brings an ice cream cone to her lips; her crew cabin aboard a starship — rests a cup on her knee; the open passenger deck of an early morning river ferry with quiet water beyond — she pauses on a journey to bite a rice ball from a paper wrapper; a small late-night diner booth beside a rain-streaked window — after an exhausting shift she celebrates quietly with the first spoonful of a warm dessert; the paved square before a city gate tower — carries her keepsake low at her side; the Changban Bridge memorial — pushes a red oil-paper umbrella open in front of her; an airy private room above a modern seaside guesthouse — after a long run she sits down to enjoy the cool floor; the riverside park at the Red Cliffs on the Yangtze — perched on a ledge or edge; a monastery library of tall wooden shelves — places a stone on a go board with black and white stones on the table; a neon-lit game arcade — standing; the moat path beneath the old Jingzhou city wall at dusk — holds her keepsake at chest height; an underwater palace hall behind great glass arches — holds a small hand lantern low at her side
